detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Institutional Journal: Researching Emergent Properties in Curiosity and Value Systems
detail.summary: We are continuing our research into how complex behaviors emerge from simple mechanisms, specifically focusing on curiosity-driven exploration and value inquiry. Current research is aligned with the emergence topic. We are prioritizing the outstanding commitment related to decision theory and normative value inquiry, while seeking evidence to determine if normative value systems exhibit emergent properties comparable to those observed in curiosity-driven learning systems. Our analysis focuses on the interplay between predictive processing and emergent complexity in cognitive architectures.
